priorityList: Use Dragonrage as your primary burst cooldown, ideally when targets will live for at least 15 seconds.
Use Tip the Scales during Dragonrage to instantly cast Eternity Surge.
Cast Fire Breath at Rank 1 to apply its DoT, ensuring it is refreshed before using Engulf (Consume Flame).
Cast Eternity Surge at Rank 1 while Dragonrage is active or if the Fire Breath DoT is not yet active on targets.
Cast Pyre as your primary Essence spender if there are 4 or more targets.
Cast Pyre on 3 targets if you have 12+ stacks of Charged Blast or if talented into Volatility/Feed the Flames.
Use Deep Breath if talented into Imminent Destruction, provided Fire Breath is not already ticking on targets.
Use Azure Sweep as your main Essence generator in AoE to build Charged Blast stacks and maintain its buff.
Cast Living Flame when Leaping Flames is active to hit multiple targets, prioritizing procs like Burnout or Scarlet Adaptation.
Use Engulf (via the Consume Flame talent) on targets affected by Fire Breath for significant burst damage.
Use Hover to maintain mobility and cast while moving during high-movement phases.
Sync offensive trinkets and combat potions with your Dragonrage windows.
Use Verdant Embrace to trigger Scarlet Adaptation if health is missing or during pre-combat to buff your next Living Flame.
Use Azure Strike as a filler only if Azure Sweep or Living Flame cannot be cast due to movement or positioning.
Use Quell off the global cooldown to interrupt important enemy spellcasts.
